attacks.name: Divine Smite
attacks.notes: +1d8 per slot level above 1st, +1d8 vs Fiends and Undead; Bonus Action after a hit

class_features.name: Lay On Hands
class_features.summary: You have a pool of healing power that replenishes when you finish a Long Rest. With that pool, you can restore a total of 25 HP.
class_features.full_text:
You have a pool of healing power that replenishes when you finish a Long Rest. With that pool, you can restore a total of 25 HP.

As a Bonus Action, you can touch a creature (which could be yourself) and restore a number of HP to that creature, up to the maximum amount remaining in the pool.

You can also expend 5 HP from the pool of healing to remove the Poisoned condition from the creature; those points don’t also restore HP to the creature.

option_details.name: Warhammer (Push)
option_details.text: Push. If you hit a creature with Warhammer, you can push the creature up to 10 ft. straight away from you if it’s Large or smaller.

class_features.name: Paladin’s Smite
class_features.summary: You always have Divine Smite prepared and cast it without expending a spell slot once per Long Rest.
class_features.full_text: You always have Divine Smite prepared and cast it without expending a spell slot once per Long Rest.

class_features.name: Channel Divinity
class_features.summary: You can channel energy directly from the Outer Planes to fuel magical effects. Each time you use this class’s Channel Divinity, you can choose which effect to create. You can use this class’s Channel Divinity 2 times per Long Rest, but can regain one expended use after finishing a Short Rest.
class_features.full_text:
You can channel energy directly from the Outer Planes to fuel magical effects. Each time you use this class’s Channel Divinity, you can choose which effect to create. You can use this class’s Channel Divinity 2 times per Long Rest, but can regain one expended use after finishing a Short Rest.

If your Channel Divinity requires a saving throw, the DC equals your Paladin spell save DC (DC 13).

class_features.name: Castigate
class_features.summary: As a Magic action, you can expend one use of your Channel Divinity to put your target in fiery shackles. Choose a number of creatures up to 2 you can see within 30 feet of yourself. Each creature must succeed on a Str saving throw or put in fiery shackles and have its Speed reduced to 0. As a Bonus Action, you can cause each creature bound by the shackles to take 2d6 Fire damage. A shackled creature repeats the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.
class_features.full_text:
As a Magic action, you can expend one use of your Channel Divinity to put your target in fiery shackles. Choose a number of creatures up to 2 you can see within 30 feet of yourself. Each creature must succeed on a Str saving throw or put in fiery shackles and have its Speed reduced to 0. As a Bonus Action, you can cause each creature bound by the shackles to take 2d6 Fire damage. A shackled creature repeats the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

After 1 minute, it succeeds automatically.

class_features.name: Incite
class_features.summary: As a Magic action, you can expend one use of your Channel Divinity. For the next 10 minutes, you have Advantage on Int (Investigation) and Wis (Insight) checks.
class_features.full_text:
As a Magic action, you can expend one use of your Channel Divinity. For the next 10 minutes, you have Advantage on Int (Investigation) and Wis (Insight) checks.

You can take a Bonus Action to choose a creature you can see within 10 feet of you. The target must succeed on a Cha saving throw or have the Frightened condition for 1 minute. While the target is Frightened in this way, it can’t speak a deliberate lie. The condition ends early if the target takes damage or if you use this Bonus Action again.

class_features.name: Extra Attack
class_features.summary: You can attack twice instead of once whenever you take the Attack action on your turn.
class_features.full_text: You can attack twice instead of once whenever you take the Attack action on your turn.

class_features.name: Faithful Steed
class_features.summary: You always have Find Steed prepared, and can cast it once per Long Rest without expending a spell slot.
class_features.full_text: You always have Find Steed prepared, and can cast it once per Long Rest without expending a spell slot.

racial_traits.name: Resourceful
racial_traits.summary: You gain Heroic Inspiration whenever you finish a Long Rest.
racial_traits.full_text: You gain Heroic Inspiration whenever you finish a Long Rest.

racial_traits.name: Skillful
racial_traits.summary: You gain proficiency in one skill of your choice.
racial_traits.full_text: You gain proficiency in one skill of your choice.

racial_traits.name: Versatile
racial_traits.summary: You gain an Origin feat of your choice.
racial_traits.full_text: You gain an Origin feat of your choice.

feats.name: Protection
feats.summary: When a creature you can see attacks a target other than you that is within 5 ft. of you, you can take a Reaction to interpose your Shield if you’re holding one. You impose Disadvantage on the triggering attack roll and all other attack rolls against the target until the start of your next turn if you remain within 5 ft. of the target.
feats.full_text: When a creature you can see attacks a target other than you that is within 5 ft. of you, you can take a Reaction to interpose your Shield if you’re holding one. You impose Disadvantage on the triggering attack roll and all other attack rolls against the target until the start of your next turn if you remain within 5 ft. of the target.

feats.name: Tavern Brawler
feats.summary: Enhanced Unarmed Strike. When you hit with your Unarmed Strike and deal damage, you can deal 1d4-3 Bludgeoning damage instead of the normal damage of an Unarmed Strike.
feats.full_text:
Enhanced Unarmed Strike. When you hit with your Unarmed Strike and deal damage, you can deal 1d4-3 Bludgeoning damage instead of the normal damage of an Unarmed Strike.

Damage Rerolls. Whenever you roll a damage die for your Unarmed Strike, you can reroll the die if it rolls a 1, and you must use the new roll.

Improvised Weaponry. You have proficiency with improvised weapons.

Push. When you hit a creature with an Unarmed Strike, you can deal damage to the target and also push it 5 ft. away from you. You can use this benefit only once per turn.

feats.name: Great Weapon Fighting
feats.summary: When you roll damage for an attack you make with a Melee weapon that you are holding with two hands, you can treat any 1 or 2 on a damage die as a 3. The weapon must have the Two-Handed or Versatile property.
feats.full_text: When you roll damage for an attack you make with a Melee weapon that you are holding with two hands, you can treat any 1 or 2 on a damage die as a 3. The weapon must have the Two-Handed or Versatile property.

feats.name: Savage Attacker
feats.summary: Once per turn when you hit a target with a weapon, you can roll the weapon’s damage dice twice and use either roll against the target.
feats.full_text: Once per turn when you hit a target with a weapon, you can roll the weapon’s damage dice twice and use either roll against the target.
